data:
Note: The deployment described in this guide is no longer active. AWS credits provided for the "Cloud Computing" class have expired after the course ended, so the infrastructure is no longer running.
The second stage of the project consists of deploying the developed API to AWS
(Amazon Web Services).The deployment was performed using Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), eksctl and kubectl,
in addition to creating a distribution with Amazon CloudFront.
data.eks-application-deployment#EKS Applicati:
Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) is a managed service from Amazon Web Services (AWS) that makes it easy to run Kubernetes clusters in the cloud.Five YAML files were created for the application's deployments and services. They are:
namespace.yaml
jwt-api-deployment.yaml
jwt-api-service.yaml
postgres-deployment.yaml
postgres-service.yaml
These files are available on GitHub.
data.create-the-cluster-with-eksctl#Create th:
eksctl create cluster 
  --name jwt-app-cluster 
  --region us-east-1 
  --nodegroup-name standard-workers 
  --node-type t3.medium 
  --nodes 2 
  --nodes-min 1 
  --nodes-max 3 
  --managed
data.deploy-the-postgresql-service#Deploy the:
kubectl apply -f postgres-deployment.yaml
kubectl apply -f postgres-service.yaml
data.deploy-the-api-server#Deploy the API ser:
kubectl apply -f jwt-api-deployment.yaml
kubectl apply -f jwt-api-service.yaml
data.all-set#All set!:
Check if the pods are running correctly:
kubectl get pods -n jwt-app
data.cdn-configuration-with-amazon-cloudfront:
As a way to make the API available with HTTPS access without the need for an SSL
certificate, a distribution was created using Amazon CloudFront — an AWS Content
Delivery Network (CDN) service.

data: The API offers authentication and data query endpoints.
data.swagger#Swagger: The API endpoint documentation was developed with Swagger and Scalar and can be accessed at this link.
data.register-user#Register user:
Endpoint: POST /register
Description: endpoint for creating new users.
data.login#Login:
Endpoint: POST /login
Description: authentication endpoint for existing users.
Authentication is performed with email and password. This endpoint returns a JWT token that should be used in requests to the data query endpoint.
data.query-data#Query data:
Endpoint: GET /query
Description: headlines query endpoint.
This endpoint returns a list of BBC headlines. These headlines are cached (in memory) and update every hour.

data: Follow the instructions below to install and run the project.
data.download#Download: Download the compose.yaml file from this link and store it in an empty directory.
data.execution-with-docker-compose#Execution:
Run the command below in the terminal of the directory where the compose.yaml file was stored:
docker compose up
data.all-set#All set!: Now you can access the API at http://localhost:3000.

data: This project was developed for the Cloud Computing class at Insper. It demonstrates an API that implements JWT-based authentication. It was built with ElysiaJS, Bun and TypeScript.
data.technologies-used#Technologies used:
The following technologies were used:
ElysiaJS: framework for building web servers
Bun: JavaScript runtime and package manager
TypeScript: programming language with static typing
Prisma: ORM for Node.js and TypeScript
And the following libraries were used to develop the web scraping service:
Cheerio: library for HTML parsing
Axios: HTTP client for making web requests
data.api-endpoints#API Endpoints: The API offers authentication and data query endpoints. Access the API documentation to view the list of endpoints.
